name: Masterwork staff
purpose: Self-sufficient material and region-pressure map for the tier-100 Masterwork staff. It records where the chain pulls a League build without pretending every tradeable ingredient is a hard region lock.

source_policy.league_regions: Use current Equilibrium locality rules when published; otherwise use clearly labelled historical Catalyst locality precedent or a geography hint.
source_policy.hard_gate_rule: Only mark a region as hard when the normal self-source route itself requires that region. A material that can arrive from another sourced route stays pressure, not a fabricated lock.
source_policy.community_use: Community launch notes may cross-check an incomplete assembly chain, but they are not promoted above current Wiki/Jagex evidence.

requirements.name: Crafting to Your Own Rune
requirements.reason: Required by the Masterwork-staff component chain, including converting inert eternal magic staves into unwrapped grips.

region_pressure.note: The essence set target is four. Vorago is the normal self-source for seismic weapons; Asgarnia follows historical League locality evidence rather than an Equilibrium-specific boundary reveal.
Each Cywir wand or orb breaks down into two Melodic essence; the set target is four.
The essence set target is four. Attuned crystal magic weapons are the normal self-source route and tie this part of the chain to Prifddinas/Tirannwn.

source_routes.note: Original eternal-magic-tree location. Keep Kandarin as a geography hint rather than a hard League lock.

requirements: Heedi's eternal magic saplings from the Piscatoris Hunter area
source_routes.note: Since March 2026, three nursery plots in Havenhythe can grow Heedi's eternal magic saplings. The saplings themselves are obtained from Heedi near Piscatoris, so this is an alternate chopping location rather than proof that the full self-source chain is Havenhythe-only.

region_pressure.note: One inert staff costs two eternal magic logs; ten inert staves make one unwrapped grip. Two grips therefore consume 20 inert staves, or 40 logs. Neither Kandarin nor Havenhythe is promoted to a hard staff lock because the 2026 nursery route crosses the old Piscatoris supply route and Equilibrium has not published a special locality rule for this chain.

region_pressure.source_content: Undead dragon leather from Zemouregal & Vorkath, then dyed for the staff grips
region_pressure.note: Fort/Vorkath uses the project's working Misthalin League taxonomy from Catalyst precedent until Equilibrium publishes its own finer boundary.

region_pressure.current_acquisition_note: Use the current fixed threshold: the 29 September 2025 same-day hotfix changed Abyssal Runic Synapse acquisition to one after 10,000 essence crafted and removed the random element. This supersedes the earlier 1/50 chance with a 75-craft bad-luck guarantee described in the initial update text.
region_pressure.note: The Abyss entrance is part of the Forinthry/Wilderness access model. Keep this as a self-source gate unless Equilibrium publishes an explicit alternate route.

The Wiki directly accounts for bricks in the grounded base and unhoused focus, while the launch-day community assembly trace cross-checks the third brick in the conduit path. Keep the total at three, but retain the weaker confidence label until one current Wiki page exposes the complete flattened staff recipe. Self-crafting Time runes points at Anachronia; rune drops, shops or other League supply can satisfy the input, so this is not a hard Anachronia lock.

planner_summary.interpretation: For an untraded self-source route the staff pulls from several region-specific weapon/material chains at once. Anachronia is conditional because Time runes can come from non-altar sources. Eternal-log geography is conditional too: Piscatoris is the original source, while Havenhythe can grow eternal magic trees after obtaining Heedi's saplings from Piscatoris.
